items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 16 at 4:14AM PST until November 17 at 3:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 7 to 9 feet. Dangerous rip
currents expected.

* WHERE...Malibu Coast and Los Angeles County Beaches.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk for ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Large
breaking waves can cause injury, wash people off beaches and
rocks, and capsize small boats near shore. Minor tidal
overflow during morning high tides.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The High Surf Advisory may need to be
extended through Wednesday, and another round of larger surf
is expected Thursday into Friday.
items.instruction:
Remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions, or stay
near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly in
such conditions, stay off the rocks.
